test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A real image of equal size is obtained at a distance of 48 cm from the lens. The type of the lens and its focal length is:

options.text: convex lens of focal length 48 cm
concave lens of focal length of 48 cm
convex lens of focal length 24 cm
concave lens of focal length 24 cm

solution:
The correct answer is __Convex lens of focal length 24 cm__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Convex mirrors, divergent lenses, and plane mirrors can never provide a** true image**.
 
• A **true image** can only be created with a concave mirror and a converging lens if the item is farther distant from the focus point (i.e., **more than one focal length away**).
 
• As the image is an equal size to that of the object. So, the object **must be at 2F** and also the image.
 
• So, the focal length of the lens must be **24 cm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19120cd011485d7a63663bcbb10d0650bfe367c63f519f401caf1b06edb06d3b.png]
